id: # Runtime voice: event chats, a chat with on= in the when of line 1. The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.
# An event chat only plays on its event, never as a normal chat: on=flag (a flag planted), on=deploy (a Breaking
# Ground part deployed on EVA), on=evareport, on=surfacesample, on=roc and the other science topics, on=science (any
# experiment). The kerbal who did it says line 1. With another kerbal nearby (aboard, on EVA or in a vessel close
# by) it is a chat of two or more lines. A kerbal alone says a chat of one line. link is 1 with a link to Mission
# Control, else 0: without a link the kerbals talk among themselves and no line to Mission Control plays. A line
# with the word Control is dropped when the link is gone, so a line without a link never says Control.
# With a link, after an EVA experiment or a deployed part Mission Control answers with a science line. A science
# line with on= only plays for its experiment and is picked before the lines for any experiment.
# Flags: the kerbal who planted it starts. flag is the name of the flag when the voice can say it.

english: {other}, look. Flag planted. | {other}, what do you think of the flag?

english: It's crooked. | Beautiful. A bit crooked, but beautiful.

english: It's the ground that's crooked. | It's style. You wouldn't understand.

english: Flag planted. At home. | {other}, I planted a flag on {here}.

english: At home? This was already ours. | Very patriotic. The gardener won't be happy.
